results.statement: When a sanity bead closes with PASS, the sanity close hook must assign the group's qa bead to the quality-mgr member with the qa template and vars as the phase lead, with no lead action.
results.quote: likewise, when a sanity-bd passes, the same task assignment occurs 'atm task assign <quality-agent> --template <qa-template> --args <vars> --as <phase-lead>
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18: Rand's close-hook and mechanical-assignment rulings (atm-core #1873 comment 1, atm-bd-orchestration #340, PR #342)
results.deterministic_check: run the sanity role with verdict PASS in a scratch repo and read atm task list: the qa task exists, assigned by the lead identity, before the hook exits

criteria.no: The item covers only something else: the dev or fix close, assigning the sanity bead, a sanity FAIL, or an unrelated area of the system.
criteria.unclear: The item mentions the close hook, sanity, or QA, but it cannot be told whether it concerns what happens after a sanity PASS.
criteria.yes: The item describes the sanity role of the close hook on PASS, or says who or what assigns the qa bead or starts QA after sanity passes.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` deal with the moment a sanity bead closes with PASS, or with handing the qa bead to quality-mgr after that PASS? Judge subject matter only, not whether the item follows `anchor.statement`.

criteria.no: The item does not contain that hook step: QA assignment is not mentioned, is left to the lead or another component, or runs under a non-lead identity.
criteria.unclear: The item refers to a QA assignment after sanity but it cannot be told who performs it or as whom.
criteria.yes: The item has the hook, on sanity PASS, run the qa assignment to quality-mgr with the qa template and vars under the phase lead identity (`--as <phase-lead>`, or the lead identity on the subprocess).

addressed.instructions: Read `anchor.statement`: on a sanity PASS the close hook must hand the group's qa bead to quality-mgr itself, as the phase lead, with the qa template and vars. Is that hand-off written into `item.text` as something the hook does? An item that leaves the QA assignment to a person, to a later dispatch pass, or to another identity does not contain it; an item that only says QA follows does not contain it. Judge presence only.

criteria.no: The item keeps the assignment with the hook or its sanity role under the lead identity, or does not mention who assigns the qa bead, or only adds a report to the lead.
criteria.unclear: The item mentions the QA assignment but it cannot be told whether the hook or the lead identity is kept.
criteria.yes: The item has the lead, a person, or another component assign the qa bead after sanity passes, says the hook does not assign it, or has the assignment made under an identity other than the phase lead.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` take the QA assignment after a sanity PASS away from the close hook, or away from the phase lead's identity? `anchor.statement` requires the hook (its sanity role in `atm-task-close.py`) to assign the qa bead to quality-mgr as the phase lead, with no lead action. Silence about the QA assignment is not a conflict; a report to the lead is not a conflict. Judge conflict only.

results.explanation: This bead proposes something the anchor rules out.
